caption: Do you guys ever have this feeling where you realise you don’t really have anyone you can talk to every single day?
transcript: Do you guys ever have this feeling where you realize you don't really have anyone you can talk to every single day? Like sure, you've got friends, but they have their own circles, their own favorite person to text the second something happens and you're just there staring at your phone, waiting for a message that never comes. It feels like you're watching everyone's life from the outside. They're laughing, choosing each other, building memories, and you wonder if anyone would notice if you quietly disappeared. The worst part isn't the silence, it's the voice in your head saying why do I need someone this much? But hear this, wanting to be seen is not weakness, it's human. Even the strongest soul needs one place where they don't have to pretend. Loneliness does not mean you are unimportant, it may simply mean you are growing into someone fewer people understand. Do not beg to be chosen, become someone who chooses wisely. And if this felt personal, save it, share it with someone who might be feeling invisible too. If this feeling has been heavy on your heart, my book, The Way Back to Stillness, was written for moments like this. You'll find it in the link in my profile. Save this and begin your way back.
